title: R3 face-parts source-point annotation (one file per part)
description: Placement METADATA for one part of one raw parts sheet. It never changes pixels. The compositor accepts it only when raw.sha256 equals the sheet's SHA-256, part/cell/layout match the fixed layout, the point names are exactly the part's names, and status is APPROVED (production). The tool (face-parts-tool.mjs validateAnnotation) is the enforcing implementation; this schema documents it.

annotationVersion.description: incremented on every correction; a correction is a new file version, never an in-place edit of an approved one

coordinateSpace.const: cell-local continuous; pixel i covers [i, i+1); origin = the cell's top-left

pointDefinitions.description: the target-points version whose 'definition' texts the points follow

points.description: exactly the part's point names: brows {inner, outer}; nose {top, bottom}; mouth {left, right}. Each [x, y], finite, inside [0, 512].

status.description: only the owner sets APPROVED; SYNTHETIC_TEST_APPROVED is refused in production

reviewFlags.description: marks the part for owner review; flags never change the transform and never set an acceptance threshold
